---
params:
  x:
  tab_title:
  type:
  meta: !r NULL
title: "\\fontsize{12}{14}\\selectfont Struktur der Verjüngung `r params$tab_title`"
classoption:
  - a4paper
geometry:
  - landscape
  - "left=0.5cm,right=0.5cm,top=1.cm, bottom=1.2cm"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r meta-block, echo=FALSE, results="asis"}
if (!is.null(params$meta)) {
  m <- params$meta
  fmt_ha <- function(x) format(round(x), big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",",
                                scientific = FALSE)
  parts <- character(0)
  if (!is.null(m$year))    parts <- c(parts, paste0("\\textbf{Inventurjahr:} ",      as.integer(m$year)))
  if (!is.null(m$area_ha)) parts <- c(parts, paste0("\\textbf{Gesamtfl\\\"ache:} ", fmt_ha(m$area_ha), " ha"))
  if (!is.null(m$n_plots)) parts <- c(parts, paste0("\\textbf{Inventurpunkte:} ",   as.integer(m$n_plots)))
  if (length(parts) > 0)
    cat("\\begin{center}\\small ", paste(parts, collapse = "\\qquad "), "\\end{center}\\vspace{-0.5em}\n", sep = "")
}
```

```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
oo <- options(knitr.kable.NA = "", fe_spec_lang = "ger")

x <- params$x

# ------------ Basic preparation ------------------------

# ensure mixture_class exists and order "total" on top if present
if ("mixture_class" %in% names(x)) {
  mix_levels <- unique(x$mixture_class)
  if ("total" %in% mix_levels) {
    mix_levels <- c("total", setdiff(mix_levels, "total"))
  }
  x$mixture_class <- factor(x$mixture_class, levels = mix_levels)
}

# choose ID column for rows: species_group preferred, otherwise species_name
id_order_cols <- intersect(c("species_group", "species_name"), names(x))

if (length(id_order_cols) == 0) {
  x <- x |>
    dplyr::arrange(.data$mixture_class)
} else {
  x <- x |>
    dplyr::arrange(.data$mixture_class, !!!rlang::syms(id_order_cols))
}

# Shorten long species names for display in the narrow Baumart column
shorten_species_name <- function(nm) {
  nm <- gsub("Sonst. Laubholz", "Son. Laub.",  nm, fixed = TRUE)
  nm <- gsub("Edellaubholz",    "Edel Laub.",  nm, fixed = TRUE)
  nm
}

# Convert species_group to German name for display (must happen after arrange)
if ("species_group" %in% names(x)) {
  x$species_group <- shorten_species_name(format(x$species_group, spec_lang = "ger"))
}

# vertical grouping index (one band per mixture_class)
vertical_index_dat <- x |>
  dplyr::group_by(.data$mixture_class) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")

clean_mixture_label <- function(lbl) {
  if (identical(lbl, "total")) return("Gesamt")
  lbl <- sub("^mix_",    "", lbl)
  lbl <- sub("^single_", "", lbl)
  lbl <- sub("^other_",  "", lbl)
  shorten_species_name(lbl)
}
vertical_index <- vertical_index_dat$n
names(vertical_index) <- vapply(
  as.character(vertical_index_dat$mixture_class),
  clean_mixture_label,
  character(1)
)

# total VVJ area (for header subtitle)
total_area_ha <- NA_real_
if ("area_ha_total" %in% names(x)) {
  total_area_ha <- sum(x$area_ha_total[x$mixture_class == "total"], na.rm = TRUE)
}

# ------------ Identify height class columns ------------------------

all_names <- names(x)

metric_prefixes <- c("n_measrured", "n_calc_ha", "area_ha", "percHoe")

# columns that belong to height classes: prefix_... but not *_total
is_hclass_col <- vapply(
  all_names,
  FUN.VALUE = logical(1),
  FUN = function(nm) {
    any(vapply(
      metric_prefixes,
      FUN.VALUE = logical(1),
      FUN = function(mp) {
        startsWith(nm, paste0(mp, "_")) &&
          !identical(nm, paste0(mp, "_total"))
      }
    ))
  }
)

hclass_cols <- all_names[is_hclass_col]

# ------------ Detect Probkreise columns (n_inv_points_*) ------------------------

probkreise_cols <- grep("^n_inv_points_", all_names, value = TRUE)
n_probkreise    <- length(probkreise_cols)

# Strip the known metric prefix to get the height class label
# e.g. "n_measrured_0.2-1.3" -> "0.2-1.3", "area_ha_1.3-5.0" -> "1.3-5.0"
get_hclass <- function(nm) {
  for (mp in metric_prefixes) {
    prefix <- paste0(mp, "_")
    if (startsWith(nm, prefix)) return(substr(nm, nchar(prefix) + 1L, nchar(nm)))
  }
  nm
}

hclasses <- unique(vapply(hclass_cols, get_hclass, FUN.VALUE = character(1)))

# keep order as in the data (cut() order)
hclasses_ord <- hclasses

# for each height class, collect all metric columns that end with _<hclass>
class_cols <- lapply(hclasses_ord, function(hc) {
  suffix <- paste0("_", hc)
  all_names[endsWith(all_names, suffix)]
})
names(class_cols) <- hclasses_ord

# ------------ Reorder columns ------------------------

# ID columns: show species_group or species_name, NOT mixture_class
id_cols <- id_order_cols

hclass_all_cols <- unlist(class_cols, use.names = FALSE)

# other columns: everything except mixture_class, id_cols, height-class metrics, and probkreise
other_cols <- setdiff(all_names, c("mixture_class", id_cols, hclass_all_cols, probkreise_cols))

ordered_cols <- c(
  id_cols,
  hclass_all_cols,
  other_cols,
  probkreise_cols
)

# Capture mixture class per row before dropping the column
mc_per_row <- as.character(x$mixture_class)

x <- x[, ordered_cols, drop = FALSE]

# ------------ Shorten metric names (drop hclass from label) ------------------------

short_metric_name <- function(nm) {
  if (startsWith(nm, "n_measrured_")) return("Anz")
  if (startsWith(nm, "n_calc_ha_"))   return("N/ha")
  if (startsWith(nm, "area_ha_"))     return("Fl(ha)")
  if (startsWith(nm, "percHoe_"))     return("%H\u00f6")
  if (startsWith(nm, "n_inv_points_")) return(sub("^n_inv_points_", "", nm))
  nm
}

new_names <- vapply(names(x), short_metric_name, FUN.VALUE = character(1))

# nice labels for ID columns
if ("species_group" %in% names(x)) {
  new_names[new_names == "species_group"] <- "Baumart"
}
if ("species_name" %in% names(x)) {
  new_names[new_names == "species_name"] <- "Baumart"
}

# totals / sum columns (they keep their own meaning)
new_names[new_names == "n_measrured_total"] <- "Anz"
new_names[new_names == "n_calc_ha_total"]   <- "N/ha"
new_names[new_names == "area_ha_total"]     <- "Fl(ha)"
new_names[new_names == "percHoe_total"]     <- "%H\u00f6"
new_names[new_names == "stammzahl_je_ha"]   <- "St/ha"
new_names[new_names == "Dominanz"]          <- "Dom.%"

names(x) <- new_names

# --- Filter out rows where all numeric columns are NA (species with no data) ---
x_num_mask <- vapply(x, is.numeric, logical(1))
if (any(x_num_mask)) {
  is_all_na  <- apply(x[, x_num_mask, drop = FALSE], 1, function(r) all(is.na(r)))
  x          <- x[!is_all_na, , drop = FALSE]
  mc_per_row <- mc_per_row[!is_all_na]
}

# --- Per-column digits: 0 for integer counts, 1 for proportions/areas ---
kable_digits <- ifelse(names(x) %in% c("%H\u00f6", "Dom.%"), 1L, 0L)

# ------------ Header bands (BaySF L43 style: height class names in outer band) -------

len_per_hclass <- vapply(class_cols, length, integer(1))

n_id    <- length(id_cols)
n_hcls  <- length(hclass_all_cols)
n_other <- length(other_cols)

# Transform internal labels (e.g. "0.2-1.3") to German display format "0,2 - 1,3 m"
transform_hclass_label <- function(hc) {
  parts <- strsplit(hc, "-", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  if (length(parts) == 2) {
    paste0(
      gsub(".", ",", parts[1], fixed = TRUE), " - ",
      gsub(".", ",", parts[2], fixed = TRUE), " m"
    )
  } else {
    hc
  }
}
hclass_display_labels <- vapply(hclasses_ord, transform_hclass_label, FUN.VALUE = character(1))

# Single outer header band with height class names directly (like BaySF L43)
if (n_probkreise > 0) {
  header_outer <- c(n_id, len_per_hclass, n_other, n_probkreise)
  names(header_outer) <- c(
    " ",
    hclass_display_labels,
    "Summe und Kennzahlen",
    "Zahl der Probekreise nach Pflanzenzahl je Probekreis"
  )
} else {
  header_outer <- c(n_id, len_per_hclass, n_other)
  names(header_outer) <- c(
    " ",
    hclass_display_labels,
    "Summe und Kennzahlen"
  )
}

header_top <- ncol(x)

if (is.finite(total_area_ha)) {
  top_label <- sprintf(
    "VVJ Fl\u00e4che gesamt = %s ha",
    format(total_area_ha, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")
  )
} else {
  top_label <- "VVJ Struktur"
}

names(header_top) <- c(top_label)

# Recompute vertical_index from filtered mc_per_row (row counts may have changed)
mc_order_all  <- as.character(vertical_index_dat$mixture_class)
mc_counts_flt <- vapply(mc_order_all, function(mc) sum(mc_per_row == mc), integer(1))
mc_nonempty   <- mc_counts_flt > 0L
vertical_index <- mc_counts_flt[mc_nonempty]
names(vertical_index) <- vapply(
  mc_order_all[mc_nonempty],
  clean_mixture_label,
  character(1)
)

# ------------ Render table ------------------------

x_visible  <- x
n_vis_cols <- ncol(x_visible)

tbl <- knitr::kable(
  x_visible,
  booktabs    = TRUE,
  longtable   = TRUE,
  digits      = kable_digits,
  format.args = list(scientific = FALSE, decimal.mark = ",", big.mark = "."),
  align       = c("l", rep("r", n_vis_cols - 1))
) |>
  kableExtra::add_header_above(header_outer) |>
  kableExtra::add_header_above(header_top) |>
  kableExtra::pack_rows(
    index        = vertical_index,
    hline_before = TRUE,
    hline_after  = FALSE,
    indent       = FALSE
  ) |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    font_size     = 5,
    latex_options = "repeat_header"
  ) |>
  # Species name column (left-aligned)
  kableExtra::column_spec(1:n_id, width = "1.2cm")

# Height class metric columns: per-metric widths
# Each height class repeats: Anz, N/ha, Fl(ha), %Hö
hcls_metric_widths <- c("0.7cm", "1.0cm", "0.5cm", "0.45cm")
n_classes <- length(class_cols)
for (k in seq_len(n_classes)) {
  n_metrics <- length(class_cols[[k]])
  mw <- rep_len(hcls_metric_widths, n_metrics)
  offset <- n_id + sum(vapply(class_cols[seq_len(k - 1)], length, integer(1)))
  for (m in seq_len(n_metrics)) {
    tbl <- tbl |> kableExtra::column_spec(offset + m, width = mw[m])
  }
}

# Summary columns: per-column widths
# Order: Anz, N/ha, Fl(ha), %Hö, St/ha, Dom.%
summ_widths <- c("0.65cm", "1.1cm", "0.7cm", "0.4cm", "0.4cm", "0.4cm")
summ_widths <- rep_len(summ_widths, n_other)
for (j in seq_len(n_other)) {
  tbl <- tbl |>
    kableExtra::column_spec(n_id + n_hcls + j, width = summ_widths[j])
}

if (n_probkreise > 0) {
  pk_start <- n_id + n_hcls + n_other + 1
  pk_labels <- names(x_visible)[pk_start:(pk_start + n_probkreise - 1)]
  for (j in seq_along(pk_labels)) {
    w <- if (nchar(pk_labels[j]) <= 1) "0.38cm" else if (nchar(pk_labels[j]) <= 3) "0.48cm" else "0.58cm"
    tbl <- tbl |> kableExtra::column_spec(pk_start + j - 1, width = w)
  }
}

tbl

options(oo)

```
